data.note:
Specimen was simvastatin, confirmed as CID 54454 / CHEMBL1064 HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor, matching Cholesterol-lowering annotation. My conclusion and protocol vote were both correct.

Phenotype was dose-shifting (large-nucleus at 0.6 uM to reproducible mitotic-like arrest at 6 uM) with NSC 3/4 high-similarity to reference of same class; visual coherence across doses remained uncertain and requested vehicle-control could not be acquired on spent budget.

reflection.text:
The correct Cholesterol-lowering call came from the quantitative atlas vote, not the visuals: 3/4 wells voted Cholesterol-lowering with high per-well similarities at 2 uM and 6 uM, and the strong mitotic-like signature reproduced across the 6 uM replicate. That reproducibility plus the rising frac_mitotic_like dose trend correctly outweighed the split microscopist candidates of microtubule destabilizers/stabilizers, Eg5, Aurora and actin disruptors.
The visuals and low-dose measurements were misleading because the phenotype switched with dose: 0.6 uM showed frac_large_nucleus z=+10.0 and enlarged cells while 2-6 uM showed shrunken cells, small nuclei and frac_mitotic_like z=+12.1 to +20.8. I treated the 3/4 NSC majority as coherence while ignoring that the low-dose well alone matched DNA replication at similarity 0.229 and that k-neighbours tied Cholesterol-lowering, Actin disruptors and Eg5 inhibitors.
The review critique was fair: protocol consistency masked weak identification and dose incoherence, with non-significant trends for cell_area, cell_count and frac_large_nucleus, sparse-field noise in the 61-cell low-dose well, and no vehicle-control schedule left in budget to answer the requested calcium-channel blocker control.
what_was_right: Prioritized reproducible high-dose NSC matches (0.763, 0.614, 0.685 for Cholesterol-lowering across e3, e8, e9) over split visual candidates, which matched unblinded simvastatin HMG-CoA reductase inhibition.

Acquired intermediate 2 uM well and 6 uM replicate which showed the large-to-small cell-area switch was dose-dependent and that the mitotic-like signal with rising tub_glcm_contrast was reproducible, not a single-well artifact.

Kept Cholesterol-lowering as lead despite e4/e5/e16/e17 visual splits toward microtubule, Eg5, Aurora and actin classes because no single antimitotic alternative was consistent across doses and atlas votes.
what_was_wrong: Over-weighted NSC 3/4 majority while ignoring low similarity 0.229 DNA-replication match at 0.6 uM and tied k-neighbour split (Cholesterol-lowering 3/10, Actin 3/10, Eg5 3/10), mistaking vote counting for mechanistic coherence.

Misread dose-incoherent morphology: frac_large_nucleus z=+10.0 at low dose versus nuc_area rho=-0.95 and cell_area rho=-0.63 p=0.37 at high dose, plus flat cell_count rho=+0.32 p=0.68, without testing whether mitotic-like rounding was secondary.

Spent acquisition budget on 4 wells without a vehicle-control schedule, so the requested calcium-channel blocker control experiment could not be run and weak-contrast dose responses and 61-cell realisation noise were left unaddressed.

- Prioritized reproducible high-dose NSC matches (0.763, 0.614, 0.685 for Cholesterol-lowering across e3, e8, e9) over split visual candidates, which matched unblinded simvastatin HMG-CoA reductase inhibition.
- Acquired intermediate 2 uM well and 6 uM replicate which showed the large-to-small cell-area switch was dose-dependent and that the mitotic-like signal with rising tub_glcm_contrast was reproducible, not a single-well artifact.
- Kept Cholesterol-lowering as lead despite e4/e5/e16/e17 visual splits toward microtubule, Eg5, Aurora and actin classes because no single antimitotic alternative was consistent across doses and atlas votes.

What was wrong or missed:
- Over-weighted NSC 3/4 majority while ignoring low similarity 0.229 DNA-replication match at 0.6 uM and tied k-neighbour split (Cholesterol-lowering 3/10, Actin 3/10, Eg5 3/10), mistaking vote counting for mechanistic coherence.
- Misread dose-incoherent morphology: frac_large_nucleus z=+10.0 at low dose versus nuc_area rho=-0.95 and cell_area rho=-0.63 p=0.37 at high dose, plus flat cell_count rho=+0.32 p=0.68, without testing whether mitotic-like rounding was secondary.
- Spent acquisition budget on 4 wells without a vehicle-control schedule, so the requested calcium-channel blocker control experiment could not be run and weak-contrast dose responses and 61-cell realisation noise were left unaddressed.

Proposed next experiment: Mevalonate / cholesterol rescue of simvastatin phenotype with filipin cholesterol staining and direct HMG-CoA reductase activity, plus phospho-histone H3 and tubulin imaging versus a cholesterol-lowering reference to test whether the high-dose mitotic-like signal is secondary.
